description: Run a native TikTok BASIC or AUDIENCE synchronous report with caller-selected dimensions and metrics. AUDIENCE supports demographics such as age/gender at campaign/adgroup levels; tiktok_get_audience_report provides a guided path. Use when a current API field is not yet in tiktok://metrics; unlike tiktok_get_insights, this tool does not calculate aliases or auto-split incompatible selections.

advertiserId.description: TikTok advertiser account ID as a string.

dataLevel.description: TikTok reporting aggregation level. Metrics and dimensions must be compatible with this level.

dimensions.description: Native reporting dimensions. Validate compatibility with the selected metrics.

endDate.description: Last date of the reporting period, in YYYY-MM-DD format, on or after startDate.

filtering.description: Native provider filter expressions; credentials and account overrides are not allowed.

metrics.description: Native or documented calculated metric names to request. Check compatibility with the selected dimensions.

orderField.description: Provider field used to order report rows.

orderType.description: Sort direction for the selected ordering field.

page.description: Page number to request, starting at 1.

pageSize.description: Maximum items requested per page. Follow the returned pagination information for remaining results.

queryLifetime.description: Request lifetime reporting instead of the explicit reporting period where TikTok supports it.

reportType.description: Native provider report type; determines supported metrics and dimensions.

startDate.description: First date of the reporting period, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: tiktok_get_report_raw

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: tiktok get report raw
